name: Mirivo
subtitle: IPTV, video & AirPlay
promotionalText: Watch your own IPTV sources with M3U and Xtream Codes. Share personal media with Google Cast and AirPlay.
description:
Watch your own IPTV sources, live streams and videos in one place with Mirivo. Add M3U playlists, stream links and Xtream Codes servers, browse channels, play video and share your personal media.

• M3U playlists, direct streams and Xtream Codes servers
• Search channels and groups

• Vehicle mode with large controls
• Screen and app-audio sharing through the iOS system broadcast control
• On-device live captions on supported devices and languages
• Interface in 22 languages with in-app language selection
• Local connection logs and optional diagnostic reports

Mirivo contains no ads. The free tier includes 2 hours of daily viewing, 1 saved source and 10 minutes per broadcast. Mirivo Pro unlocks unlimited viewing, sources and broadcasting and supported live captions. The yearly subscription auto-renews and is billed once per year. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Prices are shown in the app. Manage subscriptions in your Apple account.

Mirivo does not provide channels, IPTV accounts or content subscriptions. Use sources you have permission to access. Live captions require iOS 26 and a supported device and language. Some apps and protected content may not permit screen capture.

Source URLs and credentials stay in your device’s Keychain. Screen content, audio and captions are not uploaded to a developer server.
